name: revpro
description: Nginx reverse proxy manager with grouped sites.conf, ACME (Let's Encrypt) issuance + auto-renewal, HTTP/3 support, a web UI (local/OIDC auth), per-category port suggestion, and machine slugs
author: Martin Skalicky

help.description: Manages nginx reverse proxy site configurations. Generates per-site configs from a site-configs.conf template, issues and auto-renews Let's Encrypt certificates via ACME (HTTP-01, lego), supports HTTP/3 and Authentik auth-proxy. Bundles TLS helpers (cert inspection, self-signed cert generation), an HTTP/2,3 checker, per-category port range suggestion (ports.conf), and an embedded web UI with local (bcrypt) and/or OIDC login.

options.description: Generate per-site nginx configs from site-configs.conf
Clean, regenerate, then reload (--renew renews due certs first)
Append a site under ==domain.tld and generate+reload
List configured sites with resolved flags, plus recognized manual configs in $REVPRO/manconf
Verify configs work: cert present/fresh, generated conf up to date, upstream reachable, nginx -t passes
Convert legacy site-configs.conf → sites.conf (backs up old)
Issue ACME certs for all sites (or named ones); covers domain + www.domain
Renew near-expiry certs then regenerate+reload; --daemon loops daily
Reload or restart the reverseproxy container
Wipe and recreate conf/ and logs/
Create the folder structure / open the config
Machine slugs (machines.conf): short codes like A = 192.168.2.20, usable in sites.conf targets, group headers (==apps.tld [A] + port-only lines), port tools and the web UI
Category port ranges (ports.conf): suggest the next free port on a machine, check a port, list usage
Serve the embedded web UI (all controls); 'web passwd' sets the local login
Generate a self-signed root CA + server cert

examples.description: Issue Let's Encrypt certs for every site in the config
Run a renewal loop that auto-renews and reloads nginx
Show a live cert's expiry and issuer
Suggest the next free 'web'-range port on machine 10.0.0.2
Start the web UI (after 'revpro web passwd admin' or OIDC config)
